verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so neither is the better resize. Both have the same problems. 'Should You' has been pulled out of its framed block and placed on top of the busy hand, arm and bottle photo, so it collides with the image and is hard to read. The '=' marks and dashed rules now sit above 'Drink Water' with no headline between them, so they float loose. The yellow ribbon is crammed against the bottom edge, with 'a Workout?' nearly clipped. The careful centered stack from the original is broken and the reading order is jumbled.
